content.subject: Quick thought on month‑end close
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,
Devin Weil is now CFO at ShipMonk. I suspect month‑end close drags because matching remains manual across systems, adding unnecessary latency to financial reporting.
We connect your ERP and accounting tools to auto‑reconcile entries without manual intervention, reducing repetitive effort.
Could we set aside 15 minutes next week to explore whether this approach eases your close process?
Zamp
